headline: Fishermen's Row Rekindles as Godcrofts Front Falls Quiet
war_summary: Fishermen's Row, silent at our last edition, leads tonight's dispatch with five base events in the past two hours, the newest little more than half an hour before filing; Peripti Landing and Dankana Post bear the brunt, and its nine works now stand seven Warden to two Colonial, a marked swing from the five-and-four split last reported. The Deadlands returned to action some two hours before this edition, The Salt March and Callahan's Boot again the busiest posts, with eight of eleven works now Colonial-held. Godcrofts, the previous edition's lead, has cooled to a single event in the same span; eight works are Warden-held and one lies in no-man's-land. Farranac Coast has logged no fresh base events for better than three hours, yet its casualty pace still climbs. Linn of Mercy and Lykos Isle, both still divided, have filed no new base events for many hours, though Lykos casualties climb anew. Kings Cage and Marban Hollow, lately rising, now show cooling losses. The Weathered Expanse exacts the day's heaviest toll, more than fourteen thousand casualties on either side within twenty-four hours and still accelerating. This is the seventy-seventh day of the war; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize, and no victor is declared.
